description: Use when need to sync session work into GitHub issues OR query status of an existing track across repos. Two modes — write (end-of-session sync: find issues, update body, work-record comment, parent epic + W-label + Project placement, and clean closed tasks from active day/week plans) and read (status lookup across repos with parent/W-label/Project health). Fits the corp-init / weekly-planning / weekly-retro operating cycle. Triggers on "/manager", "sync session", "обнови issues", "синкни сессию", "зафиксируй прогресс", "статус задачи", "что по <track>", "есть ли issue по", "track status", "what about <track>".
